text:
lucy: Quick question — PR #4923 modifies auth middleware and how we persist tokens for on-prem. It introduces ONPREM_KMS_PATH and changes default token_scope to 'kv:read'. Need a quick security sanity check before we merge tonight (23:00 UTC). cc @raj @kevin

raj: I'll take a look. Main concern is token refresh flow expanding privileges. Can you paste the relevant diff or snippet?

lucy: here's the minimal diff I pushed:
```diff
- token_scope: "user:full"
+ token_scope: "kv:read"
+ ONPREM_KMS_PATH=/var/run/hsm
```
Also switching refresh tokens to be encrypted with customer KMS path instead of the default service key.

kevin: quick thoughts — conceptually OK, but need to ensure there is no local plaintext fallback if KMS is unavailable. Is there a fallback behavior?

diane: current design: if KMS call fails we don't write to disk; we keep in-memory only and surface an error to the caller. @kevin can you confirm that's how the branch behaves?

kevin: confirm — fallback is in-memory-only for the process and we return a 503 for persistence ops. That said, we should gate that behavior behind an explicit opt-in for on-prem (so operators aren't surprised). Also add a test that simulates KMS failure.

security-bot: [automated scan] Potential secret detected: tests/onprem/test_keys.json contains sample keys. Flagged for removal. :warning:

lucy: thanks — those were local dev samples. I'll remove them and replace with mock fixtures that don't contain real keys. I'll also add a unit test to assert no plaintext files are created.

sam: infra question — assuming we remove the test keys and add the KMS policy checks, any objections to merging and rolling a small canary in dedicated tonight? We can watch for 10m and roll back if needed.

raj: LGTM pending: 1) removal of the test keys, 2) kevin/diane confirmation on the explicit fallback opt-in and docs. If those are done before 22:30 UTC I'm OK to merge in the 23:00 window. :thumbsup:

kevin: checklist I'll require in the PR before final approval:
- remove tests/onprem/test_keys.json
- add automated KMS policy verification (CI) or doc showing required key policy
- add `ONPREM_ALLOW_INMEMORY_FALLBACK=false` gate (default off) and doc runbook
- add unit test that simulates KMS failure and asserts no disk writes
I'll re-review once pushed.

lucy: thanks all. Will push the removals + tests in ~20m and ping this thread when ready. Appreciate the quick eyes.
